create_pca_dimensionality_reduction: create a PCA model to reduce high-dimensional data to a lower-dimensional space using SVD
fit_pca_model: fit a PCA model on training data to extract principal components and explained variance
transform_pca_data: transform data using a fitted PCA model to project it into the principal component space
infer_pca_components: infer the optimal number of PCA components automatically using MLE dimensionality estimation
score_pca_samples: score data samples using a fitted PCA model to compute log-likelihood under the probabilistic PCA model
